eyebrow: The oracle — a phase flip on |11>
caption: Z only has a nontrivial effect on |1> — this flips the sign of exactly the |11> amplitude and leaves the rest alone.
within applies, apply runs, then the adjoint of within undoes it automatically — you never write the undo step.

eyebrow: A verified exact result — N=4, 1 marked, 1 iteration
code:
uniform superposition = [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5]
after oracle (flip |11>)  = [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5]
after diffusion           = [0, 0, 0, 1.0]

P(marked item) = 1.0
P(every other item) = 0.0
caption: Exact, not approximate — but a special case. Larger search spaces need roughly pi/4 * sqrt(N) iterations.
